name: Apollo BP-16
about: Apollo BP-16 (1965-009B), a crewed vehicle (Apollo BPS), launched 1965 Feb 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1965 Mar 22), held fixed
